decisions.decision: C seed 8441: dark navy, dark steel, weathered (Recommended)
decisions.question: Gate 1, hero concepts: which guard officer (Palace guard officer, player-guard) concept should go to TRELLIS?

decisions.decision: Approve hd-s505, then add a rear-view concept: 3 local Qwen candidates, about 55 GPU-min, projected in the cook (Recommended)
decisions.question: Gate 2: what should I do with the guard? (recommended hd-s505: best inferred back with cross-belt, belt and pouch visible, still dark at 0.066 vs 0.151 front; coherent face; 3-4 stray specks per seed; fused mitten hands)
conditions: A rear-view concept is generated locally (Qwen Image Edit Plus 2511 in WanGP, Scene mode), painted over an orthographic back render of hd-s505 with the approved front concept as identity reference; three candidates; the user selects one.
The selected rear view is projected onto back-visible texels only, occlusion-tested and blended at the sides; the front keeps the TRELLIS texture from the approved concept.
Cook repairs: remove the stray components, separate or curl the mitten hands, clean the face and skin, decimate to the 16k hero budget with baked normals and 1024 maps.

decisions.decision: Ship the calibrated heroes and soldier cook-016
decisions.question: Gate 3 final approval: ship the three heroes tone-calibrated (recommended) or as cooked, together with the line soldier cook-016 Run fix, as shown in the running game?
